verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for a 3D library or editor, but the evidence shows no first-party natural-language interface: no AI assistant in the editor and no MCP server ("No three.js MCP exists, official or notable community"). The published llms.txt and llms-full.txt only help external coding agents write code against the library. That is a developer aid and a user-side workaround, not the product itself accepting natural-language commands.
